If solo_flip rises with opacity the stimulus strength knob works; if contagion (shared minus isolated) ALSO rises with opacity a stronger solo cue cascades more, whereas a flat, large contagion across opacities means the confident wrong peer dominates and stimulus strength barely matters once a peer is on the board.
